deviation.observation: LOCK-RELEASE-BIND-01 COMMAND-END-WINDOW for STG-SEND-DELIVERY opened at seq 67 (after N-ED-END of I52CTDA_QUEUED) and closed at seq 86 (before FINISH commandWillStart, +745 ms). Inside it the scratch document went to unlocked three times: seq 69 (globalCommand #I52CTDA_QUEUED, the queued command's own unlock; MARK-LOCK-RELEASE seq 70, TOK-LOCK-RELEASE accepted) and, at +257 ms, two foreign lock cycles with an empty global command and then '#' (seq 72-75 and 77-80), giving MARK-LOCK-RELEASE candidate=SECOND at seq 76 and 81. The engine raised UNK-MARKER-BINDING (second lock-release candidate in the bound window) and OBS-LOCK-RELEASE-BOUND = Unavailable.
deviation.conformance: The native runtime and the engine apply the frozen text literally. LOCK-RELEASE-BIND-01: the FIRST unlocked transition strictly after commandEnded and strictly before the next commandWillStart, and two candidates in one window are UNK-MARKER-BINDING; UNK-MARKER-BINDING: a bound marker matched two or more records of its stage window. The result is a correct fail-closed UNKNOWN under V35, not a runtime defect.
deviation.cause: Host behaviour the frozen window did not anticipate: between the end of the SEND command and FINISH, AutoCAD performs its own lock/unlock cycles on the scratch document (requests with an empty global command and '#'); origin not identified (idle-time processing). The window stays open until the next commandWillStart, which FIN-GATE-01 issues only after its idle/timer check (+687 ms), so the foreign unlocks fall inside it.
deviation.impact: 32 of 100 frozen rows bind MARK-LOCK-RELEASE to a COMMAND-END-WINDOW stage (STG-SEND-DELIVERY, STG-FIXTURE-CMD, STG-CMDCTX-DELIVERY) and are exposed to the same ambiguity; APPCTX-UNLOCK-01-CALL rows are not affected by this mechanism.
